verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּהָכִ֞ין מַלְכ֤וּת רְחַבְעָם֙ וּכְחֶזְקָת֔וֹ עָזַ֖ב אֶת־ תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·hā·ḵîn mal·ḵūṯ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām ū·ḵə·ḥez·qā·ṯōw ‘ā·zaḇ ’eṯ- tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: After Rehoboam had established his sovereignty and royal power he and all Israel with him forsook the Law of the LORD
verses.literalPt: SUCEDEU que, havendo Roboão confirmado o reino, e havendo-se fortalecido, deixou a lei do SENHOR, e com ele todo o Israel.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בַּשָּׁנָ֤ה הַֽחֲמִישִׁית֙ לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֔ם עָלָ֛ה שִׁישַׁ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֥י מָעֲל֖וּ בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî baš·šā·nāh ha·ḥă·mî·šîṯ lam·me·leḵ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām ‘ā·lāh šî·šaq me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim kî mā·‘ă·lū Yah·weh
verses.literal: In the fifth year of Rehoboam’s reign because they had been unfaithful to the LORD Shishak king of Egypt attacked . . . Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, no quinto ano do rei Roboão, Sisaque, rei do Egito, subiu contra Jerusalém (porque tinham transgredido contra o SENHOR)

verses.original: בְּאֶ֤לֶף וּמָאתַ֙יִם֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּבְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֗ר לָעָ֞ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤אוּ עִמּוֹ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם לוּבִ֥ים סֻכִּיִּ֖ים וְכוּשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’e·lep̄ ū·mā·ṯa·yim re·ḵeḇ ū·ḇə·šiš·šîm ’e·lep̄ pā·rā·šîm wə·’ên mis·pār lā·‘ām ’ă·šer- bā·’ū ‘im·mōw mim·miṣ·ra·yim lū·ḇîm suk·kî·yîm wə·ḵū·šîm
verses.literal: with 1,200 . . . chariots 60,000 . . . horsemen and countless . . . troops who came with him out of Egypt Libyans Sukkites and Cushites
verses.literalPt: Com mil e duzentos carros e com sessenta mil cavaleiros; e era inumerável o povo que vinha com ele do Egito, de líbios, suquitas e etíopes.

verses.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֛ד אֶת־ עָרֵ֥י הַמְּצֻר֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִֽיהוּדָ֑ה וַיָּבֹ֖א עַד־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.literal: He captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E tomou as cidades fortificadas, que Judá tinha; e chegou até Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה הַנָּבִיא֙ בָּ֣א אֶל־ רְחַבְעָ֔ם וְשָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מִפְּנֵ֣י שִׁישָׁ֑ק וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָהֶ֜ם כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַתֶּם֙ עֲזַבְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִ֔י וְאַף־ אֲנִ֛י עָזַ֥בְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־ שִׁישָֽׁק׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·ma‘·yāh han·nā·ḇî bā ’el- rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām wə·śā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer- ne·’es·p̄ū ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim mip·pə·nê šî·šāq way·yō·mer lā·hem kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’at·tem ‘ă·zaḇ·tem ’ō·ṯî wə·’ap̄- ’ă·nî ‘ā·zaḇ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem bə·yaḏ- šî·šāq
verses.literal: Then Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak and he said to them This is what the LORD says You have forsaken Me therefore I have forsaken you into the hand of Shishak
verses.literalPt: Então veio Semaías, o profeta, a Roboão e aos príncipes de Judá que se ajuntaram em Jerusalém por causa de Sisaque, e disse-lhes: Assim diz o SENHOR: Vós me deixastes a mim, por isso também eu vos deixei na mão de Sisaque.

verses.original: וַיִּכָּנְע֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְהַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ צַדִּ֥יק׀ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yik·kā·nə·‘ū śā·rê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mə·rū ṣad·dîq Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said The LORD is righteous
verses.literalPt: Então se humilharam os príncipes de Israel, e o rei, e disseram: O SENHOR é justo.

verses.original: וּבִרְא֤וֹת יְהוָה֙ כִּ֣י נִכְנָ֔עוּ הָיָה֩ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה׀ לֵאמֹ֛ר נִכְנְע֖וּ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִיתֵ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֤ם כִּמְעַט֙ לִפְלֵיטָ֔ה וְלֹא־ תִתַּ֧ךְ חֲמָתִ֛י בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּיַד־ שִׁישָֽׁק׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇir·’ō·wṯ Yah·weh kî niḵ·nā·‘ū hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- šə·ma‘·yāh lê·mōr niḵ·nə·‘ū lō ’aš·ḥî·ṯêm wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem kim·‘aṭ lip̄·lê·ṭāh wə·lō- ṯit·taḵ ḥă·mā·ṯî bî·rū·šā·lim bə·yaḏ- šî·šāq
verses.literal: When the LORD saw that they had humbled themselves the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah saying They have humbled themselves I will not destroy them but will soon grant . . . them deliverance My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, o SENHOR que se humilhavam, veio a palavra do SENHOR a Semaías, dizendo: Humilharam-se, não os destruirei; antes em breve lhes darei algum socorro, para que o meu furor não se derrame sobre Jerusalém, por mão de Sisaque.

verses.original: כִּ֥י יִהְיוּ־ ל֖וֹ לַעֲבָדִ֑ים וְיֵדְעוּ֙ עֲב֣וֹדָתִ֔י וַעֲבוֹדַ֖ת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî yih·yū- lōw la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wə·yê·ḏə·‘ū ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏā·ṯî wa·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: Nevertheless they will become his servants so that they may learn the difference between serving Me and serving the kings of other lands
verses.literalPt: Porém serão seus servos; para que conheçam a diferença da minha servidão e da servidão dos reinos da terra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל שִׁישַׁ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַיִם֮ עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ אֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶת־ אֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶת־ הַכֹּ֖ל לָקָ֑ח וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶת־ מָגִנֵּ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al šî·šaq me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- hak·kōl lā·qāḥ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- mā·ḡin·nê haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: So King Shishak of Egypt attacked . . . Jerusalem and seized the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the royal palace He took everything including the gold shields that Solomon had made
verses.literalPt: Subiu, pois, Sisaque, rei do Egito, contra Jerusalém, e tomou os tesouros da casa do SENHOR, e os tesouros da casa do rei; levou tudo; também tomou os escudos de ouro, que Salomão fizera.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ רְחַבְעָם֙ תַּחְתֵּיהֶ֔ם מָגִנֵּ֖י נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהִפְקִ֗יד עַל־ יַד֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָרָצִ֔ים הַשֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ham·me·leḵ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām taḥ·tê·hem mā·ḡin·nê nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·hip̄·qîḏ ‘al- yaḏ śā·rê hā·rā·ṣîm haš·šō·mə·rîm pe·ṯaḥ bêṯ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place and committed them to the care of the captains of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace
verses.literalPt: E fez o rei Roboão em lugar deles escudos de cobre, e os entregou na mão dos chefes da guarda, que guardavam a porta da casa do rei.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י מִדֵּי־ ב֥וֹא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בָּ֤אוּ הָרָצִים֙ וּנְשָׂא֔וּם וֶהֱשִׁב֖וּם אֶל־ תָּ֥א הָרָצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mid·dê- ḇō·w ham·me·leḵ bêṯ Yah·weh bā·’ū hā·rā·ṣîm ū·nə·śā·’ūm we·hĕ·ši·ḇūm ’el- tā hā·rā·ṣîm
verses.literal: And whenever the king entered the house of the LORD the guards would go with him bearing the shields and later they would return them to the guardroom . . .
verses.literalPt: E todas as vezes que o rei entrava na casa do SENHOR, vinham os da guarda, e os levavam; depois tornavam a pô-los na câmara da guarda.

verses.original: וּבְהִכָּֽנְע֗וֹ שָׁ֤ב מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ אַף־ יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א לְהַשְׁחִ֖ית לְכָלָ֑ה וְגַם֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה הָיָ֖ה דְּבָרִ֥ים טוֹבִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·hik·kā·nə·‘ōw šāḇ mim·men·nū ’ap̄- Yah·weh wə·lō lə·haš·ḥîṯ lə·ḵā·lāh wə·ḡam bî·hū·ḏāh hā·yāh də·ḇā·rîm ṭō·w·ḇîm
verses.literal: Because Rehoboam humbled himself the anger of the LORD turned away from him and He did not destroy him completely . . . Indeed conditions were good in Judah
verses.literalPt: E humilhando-se ele, a ira do SENHOR se desviou dele, para que não o destruísse de todo; porque em Judá ainda havia boas coisas.

verses.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֞ק הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֛ם בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיִּמְלֹ֑ךְ כִּ֣י בֶן־ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וְאַחַ֣ת שָׁנָה֩ רְחַבְעָ֨ם בְּמָלְכ֜וֹ וּֽשֲׁבַ֨ע עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֣ה׀ מָלַ֣ךְ בִּֽירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָ֠עִיר אֲשֶׁר־ בָּחַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָשׂ֨וּם אֶת־ שְׁמ֥וֹ שָׁם֙ מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ נַעֲמָ֖ה הָֽעַמֹּנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·ḥaz·zêq ham·me·leḵ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām bî·rū·šā·lim way·yim·lōḵ kî ḇen- ’ar·bā·‘îm wə·’a·ḥaṯ šā·nāh rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām bə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·šă·ḇa‘ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim hā·‘îr ’ă·šer- bā·ḥar Yah·weh lā·śūm ’eṯ- šə·mōw šām mik·kōl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl wə·šêm ’im·mōw na·‘ă·māh hā·‘am·mō·nîṯ
verses.literal: Thus King Rehoboam established himself in Jerusalem and reigned He was forty-one . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned seventeen . . . years in Jerusalem the city the LORD had chosen from all the tribes of Israel in which to put His Name . . . His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite
verses.literalPt: Fortificou-se, pois, o rei Roboão em Jerusalém, e reinou; porque Roboão era da idade de quarenta e um anos, quando começou a reinar; e reinou dezessete anos em Jerusalém, a cidade que o SENHOR escolheu, dentre todas as tribos de Israel, para pôr ali o seu nome; e era o nome de sua mãe Naamá, amonita.

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ הָרָ֑ע כִּ֣י לֹ֤א הֵכִין֙ לִבּ֔וֹ לִדְר֖וֹשׁ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·rā‘ kî lō hê·ḵîn lib·bōw liḏ·rō·wōš ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: And Rehoboam did evil . . . because he did not set his heart to seek the LORD
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era mau; porquanto não preparou o seu coração para buscar ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְדִבְרֵ֣י רְחַבְעָ֗ם הָרִאשֹׁנִים֙ וְהָאֲ֣חַרוֹנִ֔ים הֲלֹא־ הֵ֨ם כְּתוּבִ֜ים בְּדִבְרֵ֨י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה הַנָּבִ֛יא וְעִדּ֥וֹ הַחֹזֶ֖ה לְהִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וּמִלְחֲמ֧וֹת רְחַבְעָ֛ם וְיָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏiḇ·rê rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām hā·ri·šō·nîm wə·hā·’ă·ḥa·rō·w·nîm hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm bə·ḏiḇ·rê šə·ma‘·yāh han·nā·ḇî wə·‘id·dōw ha·ḥō·zeh lə·hiṯ·ya·ḥêś ū·mil·ḥă·mō·wṯ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām wə·yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Now the acts of Rehoboam from first to last are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the Prophet and of Iddo the Seer concerning the genealogies There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout their days
verses.literalPt: Os atos, pois, de Roboão, assim os primeiros, como os últimos, porventura não estão escritos nos livros de Semaías, o profeta, e de Ido, o vidente, na relação das genealogias? E houve guerras entre Roboão e Jeroboão em todos os seus dias.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב רְחַבְעָם֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲבִיָּ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ rə·ḥaḇ·‘ām ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr bə·‘îr dā·wîḏ way·yim·lōḵ ’ă·ḇî·yāh ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Rehoboam rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David And his son Abijah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E Roboão dormiu com seus pais, e foi sepultado na cidade de Davi; e Abias, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
